attributes.composition: larger fluctuation range of Zr, Al, Si and Sn than Nb, Mo and Ta

evidence.section: 3.2 Effect of HIP pressure parameters on elemental distribution
evidence.quote: the fluctuation range of Zr, Al, Si, and Sn elements is larger than the Nb, Mo, and Ta elements at the HIP processing parameters of 920 ºC/105 MPa/2 h.

attributes.composition: reduced fluctuation range of Zr, Al, Si, Sn, Nb, Mo and Ta

evidence.section: 3.2 Effect of HIP pressure parameters on elemental distribution
evidence.quote: at the HIP processing parameters of 920 ºC/145 MPa/2 h, which has a higher pressure, the fluctuation range of Zr, Al, Si, Sn, Nb, Mo, and Ta elements is smaller than at the processing parameters of lower pressure, suggesting that high pressure benefits to improve composition uniformity.
The tensile strength of Ti60 alloy is 949 MPa, yield strength is 827 MPa, and the elongation is 11% when the hot isostatic pressing parameters are 960 ºC/125 MPa/2 h

mechanisms.name: enhanced diffusion by increased dislocation density

evidence.section: 3.2 Effect of HIP pressure parameters on elemental distribution
evidence.quote: the dislocation density increases with the increase of HIP pressure [14]. The increase of dislocation density is beneficial to increase Dc, and accelerate the diffusion of alloy elements leading to improved composition uniformity.
